sources.label: United Stables aggregate proof of reserves (accessed 2026-09-30)
United Stables Reserves Report as at August 31 2026 with Moore CPA Limited ISAE 3000 limited-assurance report (signed September 11 2026)

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API accessed 2026-09-30 remains genuinely single-bucket at source: totalReserve $1,540,127,120.98 and totalToken $1,497,830,391.63, updatedAt 2026-09-30T05:37:40.598Z, ripcord false. It discloses no constituent balances, contracts, custody allocation, or stablecoin weights. The contractual cash, Treasury and fiat-referenced stablecoin envelope remains a variable mix. Accepted mint or redemption assets do not prove positive holdings. Supplementary note 2026-10-19: the issuer's Reserves Report as at 2026-08-31, under a Moore CPA Limited ISAE 3000 limited-assurance conclusion signed 2026-09-11, does split that month's reserves by category: $1,284,976,249 of reserve assets against 1,275,499,208 U (100.74%), comprising stablecoins $418,354,080 (USDC, USDT and USD1; $389,453,533 held at an exchange), cash and cash equivalents $360,683,508 (including $278,574,977 at an asset manager, partly money market fund units), Binance RWUSD $304,175,870 (a principal-protected yield product held as a Binance account balance, redeemable for USDC subject to Binance quotas and fees, not transferable outside Binance and not a claim on any underlying asset) and tokenised U.S. Treasury fund units $201,762,791. Moore's emphasis of matter states it gives no assurance on the stability of the par-valued stablecoin and RWUSD balances. That dated monthly snapshot is not applied to the live single-bucket row above.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Aggregate issuer PoR at 2026-09-30T05:37:40.598Z; single-bucket source with no asset-level composition
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve value is reported as one variable basket; asset weights, stablecoin identities, banking counterparties, custodians, and liquidity terms are undisclosed.

providers.name: Undisclosed licensed and qualified digital-asset custodians

sources.label: Ceffu custody and MirrorX announcement, February 25, 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The website describes segregated custody accounts, while the governing terms state that United Stables need not segregate reserves and that holders have no preferential, secured, or proprietary insolvency claim. Ceffu's February 25, 2026 announcement confirms digital-asset custody and MirrorX settlement, but does not disclose its share, the contracting Ceffu entity, or holder protections. Other provider identities, allocations, account terms, and rehypothecation restrictions are not disclosed.
